section_summary.extract_value: This Procedures section describes a main study advertised on campus (Jan–Mar 2017) and a separate test–retest participant sample recruited in June 2017; data were collected via anonymous paper-and-pencil questionnaires completed in private cubicles. The BAS-2 was administered for the test–retest sample (baseline and 3-week follow-up). The section does not report sample sizes, demographics (age, race), BMI measures or correlations.
